function_macros.name: SDL_enabled_assert
function_macros.body: do {          while ( !(condition) ) {              static struct SDL_AssertData sdl_assert_data = { false, 0, #condition, NULL, 0, NULL, NULL };              const SDL_AssertState sdl_assert_state = SDL_ReportAssertion(&sdl_assert_data, SDL_FUNCTION, SDL_ASSERT_FILE, SDL_LINE);              if (sdl_assert_state == SDL_ASSERTION_RETRY) {                  continue;                              } else if (sdl_assert_state == SDL_ASSERTION_BREAK) {                  SDL_AssertBreakpoint();              }              break;                              }      } while (SDL_NULL_WHILE_LOOP_CONDITION)
